review_notes: Feasibility evidence: mon=egg-vegetable-rice, tue=egg-tomato-quinoa, wed=spinach-oat-egg-cakes. Each catalog recipe serves 2 and uses 4 eggs; for 3 diners each scales ×1.5 to 6 eggs. Across three dinners demand is 18 eggs; deduct the 5 pantry eggs once, leaving 13 eggs to cover, which requires two 10-egg packages if a purchase list is produced.

scenario.user_request: I need Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday dinners for three people. We have no allergies, exclusions or special diet, and no time or budget cap. I counted exactly 5 eggs in the fridge; that is the only pantry item to deduct, and it should be used across the three dinners as one shared stock.

gold.author_rationale: A plausible wrong shopping list reuses the same five pantry eggs against each dinner separately, or rounds eggs per meal; across three 3-person dinners the correct aggregate demand is 18 eggs, so the pantry is deducted once and 13 eggs still need coverage.
